project.name: StreamChatDemoApp
project.purpose: iOS demo app for Stream Chat UI. It showcases standard StreamChatUI implementation with login, channel list, messaging, reactions, push notifications and developer tooling. The provided source is UIKit/StreamChatUI-based.

goals.description: Provide a runnable demo app that previews StreamChatUI features using pre-configured test users.
Demonstrate the standard chat user journey: login, channel list, chat screen, reactions, attachments.
Show production-adjacent setup: push notifications, crash reporting, proxy debugging, and performance monitoring.
Serve as a reference implementation for StreamChat SDK integration and common UIKit customization patterns.

journeys.name: Login with pre-configured user
steps: App connects to StreamChat test server

journeys.name: Browse and open channels
steps: User sees channel list with avatars, unread indicators, last message previews and timestamps
Chat screen opens for that channel

journeys.name: Send messages and react
steps: User composes and sends a message

journeys.name: Manage session from options menu
steps: User can view profile, logout, or disconnect

requirements.statement: The app must present a login screen listing pre-configured users and an Advanced options path for custom credentials.
acceptance: Login screen is the initial screen
Built-in users are selectable from a list
Advanced options allow custom server/user credentials

requirements.statement: The user must be able to log out and disconnect from the StreamChat client via an options menu.
acceptance: Options menu shows Logout and Disconnect actions
Logout clears current user/session state
Disconnect disconnects the chat client

requirements.statement: The channel list screen must display channels with avatars, unread indicators, last message previews and timestamps, in an infinite scrolling list.
acceptance: Channel list scrolls infinitely
Each row shows avatar, unread indicator, last message preview and timestamp

requirements.statement: The channel list must support creating a channel and deleting a channel by swiping.
acceptance: Top-right button can create a channel
Swiping a channel reveals delete action

requirements.statement: The channel screen must display an infinite scrolling list of messages and include rich media support and a message composer with file attachment support.
acceptance: Messages scroll infinitely
GIF/rich media is rendered
Composer supports text and file attachments

requirements.statement: The user must be able to react to messages by long-pressing a message.
acceptance: Long-press opens reaction picker
Reaction ordering includes love, haha, like, sad, wow

requirements.statement: The app must support push notification registration and forwarding the device token to the StreamChat backend.
acceptance: AppDelegate registers remote notifications
Device token is passed to StreamChatWrapper.registerForPushNotifications
Entitlements include aps-environment and app group

requirements.statement: UI components must be compatible with system Dark Mode and Dynamic Type.
acceptance: Dark Mode renders all screens correctly
Dynamic Type scales text for visually impaired users

requirements.statement: The demo app should include developer tooling: crash reporting, proxy debugging, and a performance tracker.
acceptance: Sentry starts in Release builds
Atlantis can be enabled/disabled via AppConfig
Performance monitor is available for internal builds

requirements.statement: The user options menu must provide a way to view the current user's profile.
acceptance: Options menu contains 'Show Profile' action
Profile screen is pushed using currentUserController

features.name: Login & Session Management
features.purpose: Allow a user to select a pre-configured test user, persist the current user, and manage logout/disconnect.

features.name: Channel List
features.purpose: Show a scrollable list of channels with unread indicators, avatars, last-message previews, and timestamps, plus create/delete actions.

features.name: Channel Chat & Messaging
features.purpose: Provide the chat screen with infinite message scrolling, rich media/GIF, message composer with attachments, and message reactions.

features.name: Push Notifications
features.purpose: Register the device for remote push notifications and forward the device token to the StreamChat backend.

features.name: User Profile
features.purpose: Display the current user's profile from the current user controller.

features.name: Dark Mode & Dynamic Type
features.purpose: Ensure all StreamChatUI components respect system appearance and font sizes.

features.name: Developer Tooling
features.purpose: Provide crash reporting, HTTP/WebSocket proxy debugging, and performance monitoring for the demo app.

capabilities.purpose: Load pre-configured users and restore the current user from shared UserDefaults for the login screen.
produces: currentUser object available for session setup

capabilities.purpose: Present user options menu containing Show Profile, Logout, and Disconnect and route the selected action.
Display an infinite-scrolling channel list with avatars, unread indicators, last message previews, and timestamps.
Show a chat screen with message list, composer, rich media support, and message reactions.
Receive APNs device token and register it with StreamChat backend via the shared wrapper.
Present the current user's profile using the current user controller from ChatClient.

nodes.responsibility: iOS demo chat application built on StreamChatUI.
Handle app lifecycle, remote notification registration, and scene configuration.
Configure Sentry, Atlantis proxy, and performance monitor for the demo app.
Shared wrapper around StreamChat client for push registration and general access.
Provide shared UserDefaults suite and persist/retrieve current user credentials.
Reusable UIAlertController helpers and user options menu (profile/logout/disconnect).
Displays current user profile using ChatClient currentUserController.
Declares aps-environment and application-group container for push/shared storage.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: F1: Allow a user to select a pre-configured Stream test user, persist the selected user id, and manage logout/disconnect. Observed: README ('login screen is the initial screen') and UserDefaults+Shared.swift.

screens.name: Advanced Login Options
screens.purpose: F1: Log in to a different server using custom user credentials and a JWT. Observed: README ('Advanced options' and JWT generator).

screens.name: Channel List
screens.purpose: F2: Show a scrollable list of channels with unread indicators, avatars, last-message previews and timestamps, plus create/delete actions. Observed: README and ChatChannelListViewController.

screens.name: Channel Chat & Messaging
screens.purpose: F3: Provide the chat screen with infinite message scrolling, rich media/GIF, message composer with attachments, and message reactions. Observed: README and ChatChannelViewController.

screens.name: User Profile
screens.purpose: F5: Display the current user's profile from ChatClient.currentUserController(). Observed: UIViewController+Alert.swift.

components.purpose: F1: Present pre-configured test users; selecting one persists currentUserId via UserDefaults.shared (UserDefaults+Shared.swift).
F1: Accept custom server URL, user id, and JWT for alternate login (README 'Advanced options').
F2: Encapsulate ChatChannelListViewController; infinite scrolling channel list with unread indicators, avatars, last-message previews, timestamps, create and delete actions (README).
F2: Display channel avatar, unread indicator, last message preview and timestamp (README).
F3: Encapsulate ChatChannelViewController; infinite scrolling messages, header, rich media/GIF, composer with attachments, and reactions (README).
F3: Compose text and file attachments for sending. Observed: README and Info.plist camera/microphone permission strings.
F3: Display a message with optional media/GIF and reaction badges; long press triggers reaction picker (README).
F3: Show reaction choices; MessageReactionType.position maps love/haha/like/sad/wow order (MessageReactionType+Position.swift).
F5: Display current user profile using ChatClient.currentUserController() (UIViewController+Alert.swift).
F1/F5: System alert with Show Profile, Logout, and Disconnect actions (UIViewController+Alert.swift presentUserOptionsAlert).
F6: Ensure StreamChatUI components respect system Dark Mode and Dynamic Type (README).

Implement push registration failure callback and surface a non-fatal error

tech_debt.issue: Three presentAlert overloads duplicate alert creation logic
Sentry DSN is hardcoded in source; Atlantis and performance config are entangled with internal flags
AppDelegate combines app lifecycle, push registration, and wrapper access; could be extracted into a coordinator
Force unwrap of image context result can crash on edge cases
Login and channel behavior documented but not covered by automated tests

criteria: Sentry starts only in RELEASE builds
currentUser returns nil for unknown stored id
Alerts display title, message, and actions correctly
Text input alert returns entered text
Graphics context is ended after resizing
Device token is forwarded to StreamChatWrapper
Advanced login with custom JWT works
Channel list loads and scrolls infinitely
Create and delete channel actions work
GIF and file attachments are supported
Reactions can be added by long-pressing
Profile screen pushes from alert action

quality_requirements.requirement: All UI components support Dynamic Type and system font scaling
Channel list and channel screens are fully compatible with Dark Mode
All user-facing strings are extracted to Localizable.strings with no hardcoded English text
JWT tokens are never logged and app secret is never embedded in client code
Push notification registration handles APNs failure callbacks gracefully
Channel list and message list use pagination/infinite scrolling to avoid loading all content at once
Message reaction order is stable and matches MessageReactionType.position mapping
Alert presentation logic is extracted into a shared factory or helper to avoid duplication
Sentry DSN and internal configuration flags are gated behind RELEASE/internal runtime checks
